svg.title: archkeeper: what it sets up in your repo
svg.desc: Illustration. A node graph centred on your repo, linked to six clusters archkeeper adds: architecture map, feature memory, decisions, standards, guard hooks and design tokens. A panel lists what your agent does every session: knows the architecture map, resumes from feature memory, respects recorded decisions, follows your standards, is stopped before risky commands, uses your design tokens.
